Claim 1 (Currently amended): A method, comprising: inputting database constructs generated by a database optimizer as an input to a trained machine-learning algorithm; obtaining a database operation predictor from the machine-learning algorithm as an output, wherein the database operation predictor is a predicted execution time for a database operation; modifying at least one of the database constructs based on the database operation predictor producing a modified database construct; and processing a database operation with the database constructs and the modified database construct, wherein the processing includes executing a query based on the modified database construct.

Claim 5 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1, wherein obtaining further includes acquiring the database operation predictor as an estimated Central Processing Unit (CPU) execution time for one or more Access Module Processors to execute when processing the database operation, wherein the estimated CPU execution time is based on a comparison with historical execution times for similar database operations.

Claim 6 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1, wherein obtaining further includes acquiring the database operation predictor as an estimated number of Input/Output (I/O) operations performed by one or more Access Module Processors during execution when processing the database operation, wherein the estimated number of I/O operations is based on historical performance data.

Claim 10 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 further comprising, storing the database operation predictor in database statistics associated with the database operation and the database constructs, wherein the database statistics include historical performance metrics for similar database operations.

Claim 12 (Currently amended): A method comprising: training a machine-learning algorithm with database constructs produced by a database optimizer; receiving query execution plans for a query from the database optimizer with a least cost query execution plan identified by the database optimizer for the query; providing the query execution plans as input to the machine-learning algorithm; obtaining as an output a predicted execution time for the query based on the least cost query execution plan, wherein the predicted execution time is derived from historical execution data; and modifying one of: the least cost query execution plan for the query, a scheduled execution time for the query, and resources that are used to execute the query based on the predicted execution time.

Claim 17 (Currently amended): The method of claim 12, wherein modifying further includes selecting a different one of the query execution plans to execute the query instead of the least cost query execution plan based on the predicted execution time and a historical actual execution time known for the different query execution plan, wherein the historical actual execution time is based on previous executions of the different query execution plan.
